inputs.sequence_prompt:
subject_definitions:
<Picture 1>: Celes, exact blonde real woman in ivory puff-sleeved gown with blue waist sash and hair ribbon.
<Picture 2>: Setzer, exact mature silver-haired real man in black long coat, blue collar, gold waistcoat, ivory cravat and black gloves.
<Picture 3>: Locke, exact adult real man with blue bandana, brown hair, short black jacket, cream shirt, blue trousers and tan boots.

summary:
Fifteen-second continuous live-action preparation for departure, directly following the agreed wager. Celes puts her single coin away. Setzer puts away his cards, turns and climbs the EXISTING staircase toward the upper deck. Locke and Celes turn to watch him, ready to travel. The ship remains docked for this entire shot.

retention_analysis:
The incoming moving context fixes the precise current geography and actor positions: Locke on the left with one round wooden shield in his LEFT hand and sheathed sword; Celes center with the single coin on her open LEFT palm; Setzer foreground right, facing her with playing cards in his RIGHT glove. The wooden cabin wall and circular window are at right. The existing short staircase rises behind Celes and Setzer along the curved red-brown wooden sidewall. Preserve its actual location, treads and railing. Stone theatre, open side gate and gangway remain at left. Do not move or close the gate here. Keep bridge and dock completely stationary; undocking is a later action. Images define the same faces and costumes, not a new set.

detailed_description:
[Shot 1] (0-15 seconds) One continuous real-time shot beginning exactly at the incoming composition. Grounded bodies, distinct purposeful actions, quiet confidence after the wager. No spoken line. Camera eases slightly BACKWARD and RIGHT as Setzer turns, revealing his boots and the already-existing staircase, then makes a gentle upward pan to keep his ascent readable. It stays on this side of the actors and railing. No edit, orbit, fast pan or new staircase.
0-4 seconds: Celes curls her LEFT fingers around the coin, lowers that same hand to the fold of her blue waist sash and slips the coin inside, then withdraws her visibly empty hand. No toss or hand transfer. Simultaneously Setzer closes his small fan of playing cards with his RIGHT glove and visibly slides the same stack into his inner coat pocket, withdrawing his empty right hand. He gives Celes one brief acknowledging nod. Locke looks from her to Setzer, still carrying his shield low in his left hand.
4-8 seconds: Setzer pivots on planted boots toward the existing staircase behind him, turning his shoulders, hips and then feet together. His coat swings around his legs with weight. Celes takes one small sideways step LEFT toward Locke to clear the foot of the stairs, keeping her gown away from Setzer's path. Setzer walks two measured steps across the wooden deck to the bottom tread. He reaches the fixed stair handrail with his now-empty right glove. Nobody intersects the cabin, rail, stair sidewall or another person. The camera's small pullback shows the full route and boot contacts.
8-13 seconds: Setzer climbs the existing stairs one tread at a time at a purposeful natural pace. Each leading boot visibly plants on a tread, accepts his weight, and only then does his trailing foot lift onto the next tread. His right glove slides along the stationary handrail; the rail and steps remain solid and unchanged. Keep both boots visible during this short ascent, with no teleport to the landing or feet passing through wood. His long coat trails behind his legs. Celes and Locke turn their heads and upper bodies to follow him; they remain together on the lower deck without crossing the gate. Locke's shield stays in his left hand and weapon remains sheathed.
13-15 seconds: Setzer reaches the upper landing, plants both boots securely and briefly turns his head back toward Celes and Locke. One small outward gesture with his empty left glove invites them to wait below while he prepares the helm beyond view. Celes raises her chin in acknowledgement; Locke shifts weight onto his forward foot. End with Setzer supported on the landing, the other two below, clear change in positions and natural live motion. The ship is STILL docked; no scenery drift, rising hull, disappearing gangway, newly appearing helm, extra crew or departure yet. Stable practical light, mild wind in hair and cloth, same physical scenery throughout.

overall_soundscape:
Soft cloth and card rustle, distinct boot contacts on the wooden deck and stair treads, low evening wind and faint rigging creak. Quiet natural breathing only. No words in any language, whispering, narration, singing or musical score. No engine acceleration or takeoff sound while still docked.

non_diegetic_music:
None.
